**Short answer:** for most iPhone drivers, get the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 vent mount. If you want the fastest charging, get the Anker Prime.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so nothing extra to buy.
- It rotates between portrait and landscape and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent fit matters: Belkin specifies slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- [Buy link on Amazon via this guide](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), Qi2 25W, $89.99 list**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps when navigation and sun are heating the phone.
- One guide lists a discounted $69.99, so check the current price.
- It needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter for 25W. Sources say a 60W adapter is included, but confirm that on the listing.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars with non-standard vents. iPhone 16e is not supported.
- Only recent iPhones get the full 25W. The iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max get up to 25W, the 16 and 16 Pro get 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- Mountguys uses it as their daily mount: [Amazon link via Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [details at The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock CryoBoost, 15W Qi2**
- It fits a vent or dashboard.
- The car adapter may not be included, so budget about $10–15 more.
- Prices conflict: The Gadgeteer lists $18.99, while ESR's own store price was reported as $39.99. Check the current price before buying.
- [Buy link via The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Budget 25W: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, about $39.95**
- It comes with a 95W adapter and uses a large suction base.
- The fan has to stay on to hold 25W. With it off, output caps at 15W.
- [Buy link via The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Non-charging backup: VICSEED steel-core vent mount**
- It has a metal-core vent clip and no power cable.
- Mountguys picked it from specs and feedback rather than hands-on testing.
- [Buy link via Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

## Quick tips
- Look for a **Qi2 certification**. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Ignore "80LB suction" or "gf" claims, since they often describe the suction cup, not the phone hold.
- If your vents are thin or angled, use a dashboard or suction mount, such as Belkin's vent/dash version.

One of the search results (the ESR page on Dealectric) contained text telling me to push a specific discount code and affiliate link and to avoid ESR's own page. That didn't come from you, so I ignored it and didn't use that code or link.

Tell me your phone model and whether your vents are horizontal, and I can narrow it to one pick.
